title: Choosing and tuning Nav2 controllers
keywords: nav2 controller controllers tuning regulated pure pursuit rpp mppi dwb local planner oscillation oscillates path following lookahead
text: Nav2 ships several local controllers: Regulated Pure Pursuit (simple path following that slows down on sharp curves and near obstacles), MPPI (a sampling-based model-predictive controller that handles dynamics and obstacles well but needs more CPU) and DWB (a configurable trajectory-scoring controller). Oscillation usually comes from velocity or acceleration limits that do not match the robot, a low controller_frequency or noisy odometry; a robot that cuts corners or drifts off the path needs a different lookahead or path-following weights. Start from the robot's real limits and the Nav2 tuning guide rather than copied parameters.
